title: Sort by numerical size and retain the old order
goal: Provide numerical comparison functions to sort or toSorted and avoid modifying the input.
summary: measurement values need to be displayed from small to large, and the same original record should still retain the collection order.
tasks: completes sortReadings(readings) and returns the ascending array without changing the input.
Compare by numerical value, retaining the same numerical value and negative numbers.

example.note: If the comparison function is not passed, it will be sorted in string order. toSorted returns a new array, or you can copy it and then use sort.

hint: comparison function returns a - b; if sort is used, copy the array first.
